name: Cable Overhead Curl
summary: An isolation exercise performed between two high cable pulleys with arms abducted at shoulder height, flexing the elbows to target the biceps in a fully shortened position.

setup: Set the pulleys on a dual-cable crossover station slightly above shoulder height.
Attach single-hand stirrup handles to both sides and select equal weight.
Grasp each handle with an underhand (supinated) grip and stand centered between the towers with feet hip-width apart.
Extend your arms out to the sides at roughly shoulder height, forming a 'T' shape with your torso.
steps: Keep your upper arms stationary parallel to the floor.
Flex your elbows to curl the handles inward toward your ears.
Squeeze your biceps forcefully at the peak contraction.
Slowly extend your elbows under control to return to the starting position without letting the weights rest on the stack.
instructions.breathing: Exhale as you curl the handles toward your head, and inhale as you return to the starting position.
cues: Keep elbows high and fixed in space
Curl your knuckles toward your ears
Squeeze like a front double biceps pose

common_faults.fault: Dropping the elbows below shoulder level during the curl.
common_faults.correction: Keep your upper arms locked horizontally parallel to the floor throughout the entire set.

common_faults.fault: Swinging the torso to generate momentum.
common_faults.correction: Brace your core and isolate the movement strictly to elbow flexion.

precautions: Avoid using excessively heavy loads that compromise shoulder stability or cause excessive shoulder elevation.
